metadata.title: Partially wrapped contact Fukaya categories of 1-jet spaces
metadata.abstract: We introduce the partially wrapped contact Fukaya category of a 1-jet space equipped with a stop, which is an \(A_\infty\)-category of Legendrians equipped with representations of their Chekanov-Eliashberg algebras. This category is invariant under contact isotopies of the stop. We prove a wrapping exact triangle and a generation theorem. When the stop is bounded subanalytic singular isotropic, we prove a Morita equivalence between the partially wrapped contact Fukaya category and a microlocal sheaf category.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 范畴构造与微局部对应
analysis.workSummary: 在带stop的一阶jet空间上引入部分包裹接触Fukaya范畴，其对象为配Chekanov–Eliashberg代数表示的Legendrian。证明stop接触同痕不变性、包裹正合三角和生成定理；当stop是有界次解析奇异迷向集时，证明该范畴与微局部层范畴Morita等价。
analysis.breakthrough: 在jet空间中连接带stop的接触包裹几何和层论模型。
analysis.limitations: Morita等价的stop需有界、次解析、奇异迷向等条件；Morita等价不是不加说明的对象逐一同构，也不涵盖任意接触流形。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
